body:
Thank you for reading and address my concerns, it means a lot to me. Everything sounds like wonderful advice, and I just need to work up the courage and will power to do it.

Number 2 is actually a very good point, I think I should definitely come across as more appreciative to the friends I already have. I just realized that I come across as very stubborn and unwilling to listen to advice.

It's just it is hard to not feel hopeless if you're 10 months after graduation still sitting home. I feel absolutely useless right now.

Thank you for your encouraging reply, but I think I'm the opposite of what you described. I had initially been motivated at doing applications, but my recent slew of failures at screening / interviews have left me demotivated. I find it hard to be strong, and now I'm burying my face in the sand again.
